name: favourite-peek-badges-its-tile
description: While a Peek opened from a favourite's tab is up, that favourite's tile wears the peeked page's favicon in its top-right corner, the way Arc draws it. Escape takes the badge away. Built on favourite-off-site-link-opens-a-peek, which established that the link opens a peek at all. The peeked page is served by the fixture server, whose /favicon.ico is the icon the badge shows.

actions.expression: (() => { const tiles = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter((f) => f.querySelector('.peekbadge')); if (tiles.length !== 1) { return 'tiles=' + tiles.length; } const img = tiles[0].querySelector('.peekbadge img'); if (!/[?]r=[1-9]/.test(img.src)) { return 'no-rev'; } return img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0 ? 'loaded' : 'pending'; })()
